title: エリザベス女王杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is finally beginning, and the crowd is buzzing in anticipation of the so-called "princess showdown" between Fine Motion and Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Among that crowd stands Air Shakur. Apparently, she's here to ascertain something or other. Her expression is grim as she watches Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion is beyond excited as the dream match approaches! Though she's vexed by her newfound competitive spirit, she promises to race with all she has.
